name: JaalTaka: A Benchmark Dataset for Detecting Counterfeit Bangladeshi Banknotes
description: JaalTaka is a specialized computer vision benchmark dataset for distinguishing genuine from counterfeit Bangladeshi banknotes. Version 2 consists of 1,390 physical banknotes (802 genuine notes sourced from Sonali Bank, Agrani Bank, and Rupali Bank, and 588 counterfeit notes obtained in collaboration with the Rapid Action Battalion). Each banknote sample is captured across 6 high-resolution smartphone camera views focusing on key security features under diverse physical conditions (wear, stains, graffiti, tape/staple artifacts), yielding a total of 8,340 segment images.
